scope: Local implementation and disposable synthetic PostgreSQL only

recovery_integration.environment: node:24-bookworm-slim; disposable PostgreSQL 16; internal Docker network; no published ports; verified TLS

full_corporate_delivery.baseline: clean git archive HEAD in separate temporary directory, separately built; same seven failing subtests plus aggregate
same_baseline_failures: ✖ history exige exclusividade com o Admin
✖ history bloqueia estados corporativos inválidos e leituras pendentes
✖ history falha remota não repete consumo após reinício
✖ homologation CLI confirms exactly five, remains paused, never calls OLOS and never drains a second batch
✖ homologation CLI excludes independent source, Admin and Corporate Sync lock owners
✖ homologation holds pause against concurrent resume, blocks another CLI and permits only one attempt per instance
✖ homologation without authorization, without pause or with a structural conflict fails closed

typecheck.baseline_comparison: complete stdout identical via cmp before and after changes

limits: No proof of production schema, privileges, timing or historical collision cause.
The 479 pending records were reported by the user; no production query was executed.
Release needs permission for SHARE locks and can briefly delay local admission and remote writers.
Recovery clears only a fully revalidated INTERNAL_ID_COLLISION and leaves delivery paused.
Receipt and control changes are locally atomic; no claim of distributed atomicity.
